digest.component_or_area: tickets store / reconciler bridge state cache
propositions: Reconciler committed .bridge_state cache comprises 92% (950 MiB of 1.04 GiB) of tickets branch due to unchanged bookkeeping fields baseline_advanced_at and last_get_pass causing git delta compression failures.

Marginal packed cost per bindings.json version is 12.79 KB today; deleting baseline_advanced_at reduces it to 1.74 KB (7.4x), and moving last_get_pass to separate file halves version count (12.8x total).

Three committed-format changes (A1: delete baseline_advanced_at, A2: move last_get_pass to sidecar, A3: text-normalize baseline) with mixed-version read compatibility and reversibility enable incremental rollout without 24-hour fixed delay.

One-time history rewrite via git fast-export/fast-import pipeline reduces unfiltered clone size from 1,172 MB to 98 MB (8.4%) while preserving 49,888 commits, 2,661 merges, and byte-identical HEAD tree after dynamic re-add.

A2-2 and reclaim gates require descendant workflow execution proof, explicit runtime refresh/epoch-refusal behavioral evidence, and operator-attested quiescence (zero sessions, stopped rebar-mcp, disabled GitHub workflows) before publication.
